Press Start to generate a new crossword.
Each definition in the list has a colour. Its word uses the same colour in the grid.

letterMatcher.rulesText:

A word appears with a gap: pick the letters that complete it from two options. Practise sounds that are easy to mix up.

Complete as many words as you can correctly in 60 seconds.

How to Play:

Press Start: you have 60 seconds and up to 10 words.
A word appears with a gap and two options.
Tap the option that completes it. "(nothing)" means no letter
